components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brand gradient pill button for primary CTAs. Hover lifts and scales; active presses.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 32px; height: 48px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(102,126,234,0.35); transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(102,126,234,0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(102,126,234,0.25); }

components.name: Search Bar
components.description: Round search input with sticky positioning. Used at the top of the storefront for product search.
components.css: .ds-search { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; padding: 8px 16px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; background: #f5f5f5; color: #333; outline: none; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-search-input:focus { background: rgba(25,137,250,0.03); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #999; }

narrative.overview:
AI商城 is a premium e-commerce platform that treats product presentation as editorial craft. Inspired by Apple's product pages — spacious, confident, image-forward — but differentiated through intelligent AI features and purposeful motion. The design system rejects the cluttered, discount-driven visual language of typical Chinese e-commerce in favor of restraint that lets products breathe and AI features earn trust.

The userfront is a desktop-first web experience, not a mobile port. Layouts use the full browser canvas: editorial widths, generous whitespace, multi-column product grids, rich hover states. The admin dashboard is a separate register — efficient, dense, Element Plus-native — where merchants manage inventory without decorative friction.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial restraint: one strong visual moment per screen, white space as structure
Brand gradient as accent voice, not wallpaper — used sparingly on CTAs, section accents, and interactive highlights
Desktop-first storefront with full-canvas layouts and purposeful GSAP motion
AI features (comparison, virtual try-on) presented with clarity and trustworthiness
Clean separation between brand surface (userfront) and product surface (adminfront)

rules.name: The Gradient Discipline Rule
rules.body: The brand gradient appears on primary CTAs, section accent bars, login surfaces, and decorative circles. It is never used as a page background, card fill, or text color.

rules.name: The Price Red Rule
rules.body: #ee0a24 is reserved for prices and 'hot' tags. Using it for errors, warnings, or general emphasis dilutes its commercial signal.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built through weight contrast (700 → 600 → 500 → 400) and size jumps (≥1.25× ratio between levels), not through font-family switching.

rules.name: The CJK Line Height Rule
rules.body: Chinese text requires 0.1–0.15 more line-height than Latin text at the same size. Body text uses 1.6; headings use 1.15–1.4.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface starts flat (no shadow). Shadows are earned through interaction — hover, elevation, or focus.

rules.name: The Shadow-Transform Pairing Rule
rules.body: A hover shadow is always paired with a translateY lift (2–4px). Shadow without transform looks like a rendering artifact.

dos: Use the brand gradient exclusively on primary CTAs, section accent bars, login surfaces, and decorative circles
Pair every hover shadow with a translateY transform (2–4px)
Keep product cards at 12px radius — the userfront's corner standard
Use #ee0a24 only for prices and 'hot' tags
Build type hierarchy through weight contrast and size jumps (≥1.25× ratio)
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — every GSAP animation needs a crossfade or instant alternative
Keep the admin dashboard Element Plus-native — no gradient buttons, no pill shapes
Use the full browser canvas for the userfront storefront
donts: Use the brand gradient as a page background, card fill, or text color
Use #ee0a24 for errors, warnings, or general emphasis
Use border-radius above 16px on cards (24/28/32/40px reads as 'insanely rounded')
Pair border: 1px solid X with box-shadow: 0 Npx Mpx where M >= 16px on the same element
Add tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section heading
Use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient)
Force dark mode on the admin dashboard
Use the Vant mobile layout patterns for the userfront — it's a desktop web experience
Use all-caps body copy — reserve uppercase for short labels and product tag badges
